app.name: Loopla
app.tagline: 10 minutes a day — Korean that sticks

hero.title: Everyday Korean, built on the English you know
hero.subtitle: Learn Korean starting from English you already understand. FSRS brings each phrase back right before you forget — from your first words to natural, everyday speech.

srs.title: Spaced repetition (SRS)
srs.desc: Powered by FSRS — the modern successor to Anki's algorithm

pronunciation.title: Hangul for every phrase
pronunciation.desc: See the Korean script and meaning for every expression and pick up reading as you go

levels.title: Level-by-level path
levels.desc: Six graded levels, from your first Korean phrases to advanced, natural speech

ai.title: Fill-in-the-blank quiz
ai.desc: Pick the right word from the choices to recall Korean actively

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.step2: See the English prompt, then recall how to say it in Korean
howItWorks.step3: Rate your recall — the next review is scheduled automatically
howItWorks.step4: Track progress by level and move up to the next stage

onboarding.title: What's your level?
onboarding.subtitle: You'll learn Korean phrases from this level. Change it anytime in settings.

levels.A1: Brand new to Korean — start with greetings & basics
levels.B1: I can hold basic conversations, want them smoother
levels.B2: I want to express opinions and feelings in Korean
levels.C1: Comfortable in work and professional situations

lang.title: Which language do you speak?
lang.subtitle: Pick the language you're comfortable with — that sets what you'll learn.

summary.title: You're all set! 🎉
summary.note: Cards come back right before you forget. Ready for your first one?
